executionModeSelection.reason: Schema 1.0 enforced real-customer evidence and is therefore migrated as live mode.

nonNegotiablePrinciples.statement: A human Decider owns consequential choices.
The prototype is designed to answer agreed questions.
Only suitable real customers provide customer evidence.
Observed evidence is separated from inference.

01-intake.canonicalPurpose: Frame the consequential challenge, intended outcome, constraints, evidence, and unknowns before committing to a sprint.

02-qualify.canonicalPurpose: Choose a route that matches the uncertainty instead of applying sprint ceremony by default.

03-evidence.canonicalPurpose: Create shared understanding from relevant knowledge and evidence before solution generation.
03-evidence.defaultMethod: Sourced evidence review and early recruitment planning
03-evidence.selectedMethod: Sourced evidence review and early recruitment planning

04-foundation.canonicalPurpose: Establish a coherent customer, problem, advantage, alternative, and differentiation hypothesis when one does not yet exist.

05-map.canonicalPurpose: Build shared understanding of the customer journey or system and select the most consequential target moment.

06-questions.canonicalPurpose: Turn the long-term goal and riskiest assumptions into agreed questions and observable failure signals.

07-explore.canonicalPurpose: Diverge independently into multiple concrete, evidence-aware solution directions before evaluating them.
07-explore.defaultMethod: Independent concrete solution directions with a sourced precedent scan
07-explore.selectedMethod: Independent concrete solution directions with a sourced precedent scan

08-decide.canonicalPurpose: Converge deliberately on one coherent direction while keeping decision criteria, dissent, and rejected alternatives visible.
08-decide.defaultMethod: Independent role assessments followed by the human Decider
08-decide.selectedMethod: Independent role assessments followed by the human Decider

09-experiment.canonicalPurpose: Translate the chosen direction into a fixed hypothesis, realistic storyboard, and observable test signals.

10-prototype.canonicalPurpose: Build and trial-run the smallest realistic prototype capable of answering the agreed questions.
10-prototype.defaultMethod: Bounded prototype build with independent critique and research-readiness review
10-prototype.selectedMethod: Bounded prototype build with independent critique and research-readiness review

11-customer-sessions.canonicalPurpose: Observe suitable real customers encountering the prototype under a consistent protocol.
11-customer-sessions.defaultMethod: Planned one-to-one sessions with suitable real customers
11-customer-sessions.selectedMethod: Planned one-to-one sessions with suitable real customers

12-synthesis.canonicalPurpose: Compare observed customer evidence against the predefined questions and expose patterns, contradictions, outliers, and limitations.
12-synthesis.defaultMethod: Traceable question-by-question synthesis with independent critique
12-synthesis.selectedMethod: Traceable question-by-question synthesis with independent critique

13-outcome.canonicalPurpose: Make a bounded human-owned decision that states what was learned, what remains unknown, and the next learning action.
13-outcome.defaultMethod: Evidence-limited outcome decision and owned handoff
13-outcome.selectedMethod: Evidence-limited outcome decision and owned handoff

limitations: Customer findings remain directional and must state sample, protocol, and prototype limitations.

fidelity.teamModelLimitation: AI specialists expand the range of analysis but do not provide independent human stakeholder knowledge or customer evidence.

methodProfileSelection.reason: Schema 1.0 represented the adaptive one-human-plus-AI workflow implicitly.
